items.title: Renew Birmingham business license
items.authority: City of Birmingham Finance Department, Tax and License Administration Division
items.description: Businesses in Birmingham need a city business license. The license year runs January 1 to December 31, every license expires on December 31, and a general business license is due for renewal on January 1 and becomes delinquent after February 15, with penalties and interest after that. Many fees are a percentage of gross receipts: a new business's first-year fee is estimated from its first 90 days on a sworn affidavit, and the second year's fee is based on annualized gross receipts.

feeDetail.note: based on gross receipts for many businesses

items.title: Renew Huntsville business license
items.description: Licenses expire December 31; renewal is due January 31, a 15% penalty applies from February 1 and 30% from March 1 (insurance licenses are due the last day of February).

items.title: Renew Mobile business license
items.description: Licenses expire December 31, are due January 1 and become delinquent after January 31; a 15% penalty applies in February and 30% from March 1.

items.title: Renew Montgomery business license
items.authority: City of Montgomery License and Revenue Division
items.description: Licenses expire December 31. The city sets the penalty-free renewal date each year (February 2 for 2026) with a 15% penalty after and 30% a month later; city tax accounts must be current.
items.deadline: Set by the city each year (late January or early February)

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Tuscaloosa
items.description: Tuscaloosa requires a business license for businesses operating in the city or police jurisdiction; renewals are due February 15 each year, with penalty and interest after the deadline.

note: Tuscaloosa city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Hoover
items.description: Hoover requires a city business license and renews licenses on a calendar-year basis; applicable sales, use, rental, lodging and other tax filings may have separate deadlines.

note: Hoover city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Auburn
items.description: Auburn requires a city business license before commencing business; licenses renew annually, with delinquent charges after February 15. The first-year general license fee is $100 plus a $5 issuance fee, subject to business classification.

note: Auburn city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Dothan
items.description: Dothan requires a city business license for businesses operating in the city and notes that businesses may also need food, alcohol, building or county approvals; licensing applies separately in each municipality or county where business is conducted.

note: Dothan city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Madison
items.description: Madison requires commercial and residential-based businesses to renew city business licenses annually; licenses run January 1 through December 31 and the renewal deadline is January 31.
